migration failure is never silently treated as a new session
event identity/order and terminal evidence preserved
fork inheritedEventCount/isSeeded preserved
downgrade feasibility explicitly recorded (even when not downgradable)
unknown/future format version fails closed with the documented refusal

criterion_results.criterion: 0.1.2 historical -> migrate -> V3 -> read -> resume -> append -> close -> reopen succeeds
migration failure is never silently treated as a new session

criterion_results.evidence: sequence_continuity=true and missing_from_target=[] for every fixture; interrupted and compacted terminal evidence retained
f-forked isSeeded=true, inherited cut marker seq 7 maps to target inheritedEventCount 9

substages.name: Native Session Resume Qualification
criteria: every failure-matrix row classified as reattached | rehydrated-native | rehydrated-byq-fallback | interrupted
public fresh/reattached/rehydrated/interrupted contract unchanged
internal diagnostic fields are evidence-only and do not leak
DSH session id never becomes BYQ AgentSession identity
native resume failure falls back without fabricating reattach
zero stale lease across adapter/host restart

criterion_results.criterion: every failure-matrix row classified as reattached | rehydrated-native | rehydrated-byq-fallback | interrupted
criterion_results.evidence: native-resume-results.v1.json rows: reattached 3 (browser/frontend/gateway), rehydrated-native 4 (adapter restart, generation replacement, host reboot, executor takeover), interrupted 1 (DSH crash with a lost run), rehydrated-byq-fallback 0 for the eight rows; a native-unavailable control rehydrates via BYQ fallback
packages/contracts/runtime_continuity.py CONTINUITY_VERSION=runtime-continuity.v1 and STATUSES unchanged; summary.public_contract_unchanged=true; the manifest public_contract matches

criterion_results.criterion: internal diagnostic fields are evidence-only and do not leak
criterion_results.evidence: classifier emits native_resume_used/byq_fallback_used/previous_generation_state/native_session_present in an internal diagnostics dict only; tests assert every decision uses a closed public status and the diagnostics keys are the manifest's internal-only fields

criterion_results.criterion: DSH session id never becomes BYQ AgentSession identity
criterion_results.evidence: classify_generation_transition takes no identity; evidence records native_session_present as a boolean only; no DSH session id is projected as a BYQ identity

criterion_results.criterion: native resume failure falls back without fabricating reattach
criterion_results.evidence: native-unavailable control: an unmaterialized session is invisible to stat/open (native_resume_available=false) and classifies as rehydrated with byq_fallback_used=true; a lost run classifies interrupted, never reattached

criterion_results.criterion: zero stale lease across adapter/host restart
criterion_results.evidence: dsh-crash and host-reboot rows: SIGKILL of the lease holder releases the kernel flock; a new generation opens the same session (lease_released_on_process_death=true); executor-takeover shows SessionAlreadyOwnedError while the old executor lives

substages.name: Subagent/Fork Continuity Qualification
criteria: parent/child durable identity and lineage authorization verified
child session persistence and continuable descriptor verified
cold resume of a continuable child verified
fork lineage distinct from parent; inherited prefix preserved
model/provider, persona, reasoning effort and tool permissions/filter preserved
parent crash, child crash, adapter restart and host restart handled without second persistence

substages.name: Persistent Terminal Qualification
criteria: PTY/process existence separated from attachment existence
I/O rebind separated from stable terminal identity
terminal decoupled from AgentSession lifecycle
BYQ owns TerminalAttachment identity/state/auth/reconnect; DSH owns PTY/shell/I/O
no false reattach after DSH runtime restart or host reboot

substages.name: Architecture Go/No-Go
criteria: capability matrix over D15-2..D15-5 complete
Go/No-Go report committed; No-Go lists exact blockers
Go does not authorize production cutover
